scripts.dev: bun run scripts/ensure-dev-vars.ts && bun run build && CI=1 wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --local && wrangler dev --port 8808 --var PUBLIC_ORIGIN:http://127.0.0.1:8808 --var MINT_ENABLED:true --var TURNSTILE_LOCAL:1 --var EMAIL_SINK:1 --var MAIL_FROM:drive@localhost --var TURNSTILE_SITE_KEY:1x00000000000000000000AA
scripts.lifecycle: bunx wrangler r2 bucket lifecycle set r2-drive-placeholder --file lifecycle.json
scripts.deploy: bun run build && CI=1 wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --remote && wrangler deploy && bun run lifecycle
scripts.typecheck: wrangler types && tsc -p tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.client.json --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.test.json --noEmit
